statement: Always cite the source document at the end of every answer.
explanation: Persistent standard applied to all outputs by default = Rule.

statement: When a student requests exam practice, follow these 4 steps: pick questions → set timer → mark answers → suggest weak areas.
explanation: A repeatable on-demand workflow for a specific task = Skill.

statement: Never share student grades with other students.
explanation: A permanent safety boundary applied to all interactions = Rule.

statement: When reviewing a Python file, check for syntax errors then logic errors then missing comments in that order.
explanation: An on-demand step-by-step procedure for code review = Skill.

statement: Always use plain English and avoid technical jargon.
explanation: A default communication standard applied to every reply = Rule.

statement: To generate a lesson plan: get the topic, grade, duration, and objective — then produce starter, explanation, activity, and exit ticket.
explanation: A structured workflow invoked for lesson planning = Skill.

statement: Do not send any message outside the classroom system without human approval.
explanation: A safety rule that applies at all times without needing to be triggered = Rule.

statement: When summarising lecture notes, extract key definitions, list the 3 main ideas, and add 2 practice questions.
explanation: A named reusable procedure for note summarisation = Skill.

statement: Treat all student data as private and do not store personal information.
explanation: A persistent data privacy rule across all sessions = Rule.

statement: For capstone peer review, check: problem clarity → AI feature justification → safety rules → model choice rationale.
explanation: A step-by-step quality-check workflow run on demand = Skill.

statement: Always end responses with a one-line summary if the answer is longer than 200 words.
When the student asks for a study plan, ask for their available hours, subjects, and exam dates before creating it.
explanation: A specific on-demand information-gathering and planning workflow = Skill.
